cross_source_anchor_checks.scope: Retained-source anchor comparison. Receipt roots remain unverified here.

method: Each row preserves one transaction in one source. The Ethereum archive uses at least five distinct matched log indices from its original eight-signature set. Other EVM captures use at least two distinct matched log indices from six supported Swap signatures. The builder deduplicates exact in-source logs and reconciles secondary Ethereum aggregate event counts to the full-day counts.
limits: This public signature screen leaves pool bytecode, receipt roots, direction, funding, amounts, gas, attribution and profitability unverified. SQD projections omit event data. RPC logs retain address and topic filters. Coverage beyond listed ranges and filters is unknown. The same transaction can meet different source filters.
